body.x: Alwaygen (CEO Minsub Chung) will showcase its groundbreaking molecular diagnostics platform at CES 2025 in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10 as part of the K-Startup Pavilion.

The company aims to revolutionize molecular diagnostics by addressing accessibility challenges with its innovative EZprep PCR platform. Unlike traditional methods that rely on complex pre-processing equipment, EZprep utilizes patented lipid-based chemical purification to directly isolate nucleic acids (DNA/RNA) for PCR testing, eliminating the need for bulky and expensive instruments.

CEO Minsub Chung, a chemical engineering professor at Hongik University, developed the technology in response to the limitations of existing diagnostic tools exposed during the COVID-19 pandemic. While PCR is celebrated for its accuracy, its dependence on costly equipment and specialized personnel limits its use in smaller healthcare settings, veterinary clinics, and agricultural sites.

Alwaygen’s technology simplifies pre-processing, enabling high-performance molecular diagnostics even in environments with limited resources. The EZprep platform is designed as a versatile PCR solution that can handle multiple diagnostic applications by swapping out cartridge-based reagents, allowing seamless transitions between tests for various diseases. Currently, the platform targets applications like pet dermatological conditions, avian influenza, and foot-and-mouth disease, with plans to expand into human diagnostics for respiratory illnesses, sexually transmitted infections, and cancer-related viruses.

body.cap: EZprep PCR Device | Photo provided by Alwaygen

body.x: The portable EZprep PCR device operates on batteries, eliminating the need for high-maintenance centrifuges or heating systems. This innovation reduces diagnostic complexity, making molecular testing accessible in remote areas such as farms, border checkpoints, and small medical facilities. The proprietary chemical purification process streamlines sample preparation, cutting down on time and minimizing errors during testing.

The platform’s modular cartridge system further enhances usability and cost-efficiency, allowing users to switch between tests without investing in new devices. Its compact and cost-effective design positions EZprep as a game-changer for institutions with budget constraints or low testing volumes.

Alwaygen’s software complements the hardware by offering intuitive real-time monitoring of amplification curves and results, even for non-specialists. Plans include cloud integration for remote collaboration in epidemic monitoring and R&D applications, broadening the platform’s utility.

The company has already validated its solutions in domestic veterinary and agricultural markets and is setting its sights on global expansion. Initial targets include the U.S. and European markets, where regulatory approvals from agencies like the FDA and EMA are underway. Alwaygen plans to partner with local distributors and institutions to establish a strong foothold.

Simultaneously, the company is exploring opportunities in Southeast Asia and the Middle East, tailoring its offerings to meet regional needs, such as low-cost, temperature-stable diagnostic solutions for endemic livestock diseases. Collaborative projects with government agencies and international development programs are also part of the roadmap.

body.cap: EZprep PCR Device | Photo provided by Alwaygen

body.x: Looking ahead, Alwaygen plans to extend its reach into human diagnostics by preparing for GMP certification and clinical trials. The company envisions a future where its platform serves as a global standard for point-of-care (POC) testing, addressing critical health challenges across developed and emerging markets.

To achieve this, Alwaygen is advancing its chemical processing efficiency and developing AI-powered diagnostic software to enhance speed and accuracy. Alwaygen aims to empower users worldwide, from rural farmers to urban hospitals, by simplifying the molecular diagnostics process, contributing to global health and disease prevention.

“Alwaygen’s long-term vision is to establish our POC diagnostics platform as a global standard, enabling users from all backgrounds to access precise molecular testing. Through affordable, simplified, yet highly accurate diagnostic tools, we aim to enhance global healthcare outcomes and improve disease management across human, veterinary, and agricultural sectors,” said a company representative.
